title: BJP to protest during Winter Session at Suvarna Soudha

ai.summary: BJP plans protest during Winter Session in Belagavi against Congress-led government's failure to develop North Karnataka and address drought issues.

facts.claim: BJP members plan to stage a protest during the upcoming Winter Session of the State Legislature at the Suvarna Soudha in Belagavi
facts.quote: BJP members plan to stage a protest during the upcoming Winter Session of the State Legislature at the Suvarna Soudha in Belagavi against what they call “the complete failure of the Congress-led government in developing North Karnataka and in addressing the problems of the people of the State”.

facts.claim: The protest is planned on December 3
facts.quote: The protest is planned on December 3.

facts.claim: The party will also fight inside the Legislature by raising issues involving North Karnataka development, neglect of irrigation schemes, insufficient drought relief and price rise
facts.quote: He said that the party will also fight inside the Legislature by raising issues involving North Karnataka development, neglect of irrigation schemes, insufficient drought relief and price rise.

facts.claim: BJP has decided to seek a special discussion on North Karnataka for five days during the nine-day session
facts.quote: He said that the BJP has decided to seek a special discussion on North Karnataka for five days during the nine-day session.

facts.claim: The State government has failed to provide drought relief
facts.quote: He said that the State government has failed to provide drought relief.

facts.claim: The State government has not adequately addressed the hardships faced by farmers and the general public due to the drought
facts.quote: He said that the State government has not adequately addressed the hardships faced by farmers and the general public due to the drought.
